title: feat(minline): f_min fills from 3-site line seed with history (3,9,12)
science: Extends #6411's degeneracy to a second seed: from the 3-site long-axis line S, f_min fills with T=2 and history (3,9,12) - identical to f_L1's. The runner verifies the mechanism directly by collecting every axis type that ever appears as an unlocking configuration from S and checking that NEITHER mixed3 (1,1,1) NOR opp2 (0,1,2) is among them. So both displayed seeds probe only the wt1/adj2/vertex3
